item.title: Virtual Machines - Critical Outage in Australia East
item.description: Customers in Australia East may be experiencing connectivity issues with Virtual Machines. Engineering is engaged.

item.title: Storage Accounts - Degraded Performance in Australia Southeast
item.description: We are investigating reports of degraded storage performance in Australia Southeast region. Workaround: switch to geo-redundant storage in Australia East.

item.description: The earlier issue with App Service in Australia Central has been resolved. Customers should no longer experience delays.

item.title: Active Directory - Advisory for all regions
item.description: We have an advisory notice for Azure Active Directory customers worldwide. This is informational only; no impact to authentication.
